svg.title: results mixed scenes
svg.desc: Four panels compare recorded mixed-scene and revisit cluster counts, mixed-scene verified-pair precision and cluster purity, mixed-scene median camera-centre errors, and CPU mapping time. Expected clusters are three for mixed and one for revisit. The learned arm reports two in both. The default revisit configuration was not reported, shown as NR rather than zero.

cc:Work.dc:description: Four panels compare recorded mixed-scene and revisit cluster counts, mixed-scene verified-pair precision and cluster purity, mixed-scene median camera-centre errors, and CPU mapping time.
